item.title: iOS 26 has new Home Screen setting for app icons, here’s how to use it
item.description: Apple has added a lot of new ways to customize your iPhone in recent years. One of my favorites is a Home Screen setting in iOS 26 for your app icons that tints the icon color to match that of your iPhone or its case. Here’s how to use it. more…

item.title: Apple’s new Studio Display and Studio Display XDR have two different chips

item.title: Walmart will continue selling Macs after proving market for MacBook Neo
item.description: Walmart is staying in the business of selling Macs, with the retailer officially selling the $599 MacBook Neo. That’s no surprise since Apple basically used Walmart as the proving ground for a lower-cost Mac laptop without the fastest processor. more…

item.title: Apple Music introduces metadata tags to disclose AI-generated content
